# Sampling Wood Cores {.unnumbered}

Some thinking regarding the sampling of wood cores in Belterra, complementing 2025 sampling

```{r set}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(flextable)
library(scales)
```

```{r data}
#| message: false
inventory <- readxl::read_excel("data/raw/inventory/inventory_Belterra_20260618.xlsx",
                                sheet = "22092026") %>% 
              select(PLACA, NOME_COMUM, NOME_CIENTIFICO, FAMILIA, 
                     CAP1, CAP2, CAP3, CAP4, CAP5, CAP6, CAP7, E, N) %>% 
              mutate(across(num_range("CAP", 1:7), as.numeric)) %>% 
              rename(tree = PLACA,
                     vernacular = NOME_COMUM,
                     botanical = NOME_CIENTIFICO,
                     family = FAMILIA,
                     x_utm = E,
                     y_utm = N) %>% 
              mutate(botanical = str_extract(botanical, "^\\S+\\s+\\S+"), 
                     bota_code = paste0(
                       str_sub(word(botanical, 1), 1, 2),
                       str_sub(word(botanical, 2), 1, 2)),
                     label = paste0(bota_code, "_", tree),
                     botanical = replace_values(botanical, "Byrsonima crassifólia" ~ "Byrsonima crassifolia"),
                     bota_code = replace_values(bota_code, "NANA" ~ NA)) %>% 
              rowwise() %>% 
              mutate(dbh = max(CAP1, CAP2, CAP3, CAP4, CAP5, CAP6, CAP7)/pi) %>% 
              select(tree, x_utm, y_utm, 
                     vernacular, botanical, family, bota_code, label, dbh) %>% 
              ungroup() # to remove row_wise


meas_2025 <- read_csv("./outputs/trait_PlantForAdapt_Belterra_2025_v1.csv") %>% 
              mutate(botanical = str_extract(botanical, "^\\S+\\s+\\S+")) %>% 
              group_by(tree, botanical, verna_code) %>% 
              summarise(n_la_2025 = sum(!is.na(la)),
                        n_ldmc_2025 = sum(!is.na(ldmc)),
                        n_lt_2025  = sum(!is.na(lt)),
                        n_sla_2025 = sum(!is.na(sla)),
                        n_tlp_2025 = sum(!is.na(tlp))) %>% 
              ungroup()

wd2025 <- readxl::read_excel("data/raw/inventory/sample_taken.xlsx",
                                sheet = "Feuil1") %>%
                  rowwise() %>%
                  mutate(n_core_2025 = sum(c(Wood1 + Wood2), na.rm=T))

meas_2025 <- meas_2025 %>%
                      full_join(wd2025[,c("n_core_2025","tree")], by='tree')%>%
                      mutate(across(c(n_la_2025, n_ldmc_2025, n_lt_2025, n_sla_2025, n_tlp_2025, n_core_2025), ~ replace_na(.x,0)))


#### Filling botanical names absent from WD2025
for(i in 1:dim(meas_2025)[1]){
  if(is.na(meas_2025$botanical[i])) {meas_2025$botanical[i] <- inventory$botanical[inventory$tree == meas_2025$tree[i]] }            
  #if(is.na(meas_2025$verna_code[i])) {meas_2025$verna_code[i] <- inventory$bota_code[inventory$tree == meas_2025$tree[i]] }  
}

inventory <- inventory %>% 
                      left_join(meas_2025)

planted <- readxl::read_excel("data/raw/inventory/planted_sp_Belterra.xlsx",
                              sheet = "planted_sp_Belterra",
                              na = c("", "NA")) %>% 
                   mutate(across(c(planted, ppd_sen, native) , as.logical))

inventory <- inventory %>% 
  left_join(planted)

n_tree_tot <- length(unique(inventory$tree))

abd <- inventory %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  filter(!is.na(botanical)) %>% 
  count(botanical, bota_code, planted, ppd_sen, native) %>% 
  arrange(desc(n)) %>% 
  mutate(prop = n/n_tree_tot,
         cum_prop = cumsum(prop),
         sampled_2025 = ifelse(botanical %in% unique(meas_2025$botanical),
                               TRUE,
                               FALSE))


 pal <- col_numeric(c("tomato", "gold", "forestgreen"), domain = c(0, 5))
 pal2 <- col_numeric(c("tomato", "gold", "forestgreen"), domain = c(0, 2))
```

## Leaf and Wood sampled in 2025

The table below is the same as the table found in "sampling" chapter with the number of individual ('n_core_2025') sampled in 2025.

```{r}
#| message: false
meas_ind <- meas_2025 %>%          
                        group_by(botanical)  %>%
                        mutate(n_core_2025 = n_core_2025/2) %>%
                        summarise( across(c(n_la_2025, n_ldmc_2025, n_lt_2025, n_sla_2025, n_tlp_2025, n_core_2025),
                                         ~ sum(.x != 0)),
                                  .groups = "drop_last") %>% 
                        left_join(select(abd, botanical, bota_code, planted, ppd_sen, sampled_2025, n), by = "botanical")

            meas_ind %>% 
                        select(-bota_code, -sampled_2025) %>% 
                        flextable() %>% 
                        bg(j = c("n_la_2025", "n_ldmc_2025", "n_lt_2025", "n_sla_2025", "n_tlp_2025","n_core_2025"),
                           bg = function(x) pal(pmin(x, 5)),
                           part = "body") %>% 
                        autofit()

```

Filtering not planted species and n \< 50

```{r}
#| message: false
#| include: true
meas_ind <- meas_ind %>% filter(planted == T )%>% 
                          filter( n >50)
                     
meas_ind %>% 
                        select(-bota_code, -sampled_2025) %>% 
                        flextable() %>% 
                        bg(j = c("n_la_2025", "n_ldmc_2025", "n_lt_2025", "n_sla_2025", "n_tlp_2025","n_core_2025"),
                           bg = function(x) pal(pmin(x, 5)),
                           part = "body") %>% 
                        autofit()




```

For species already sampled in 2025 for leaves and for which it is needed to sample new leaves in 2027. We may consider to sample leaves on individual we already have wood cores :

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| include: TRUE
#| 
meas_2025 %>%          
                        group_by(botanical)  %>%
                        mutate(n_core_2025 = n_core_2025/2) %>%
                        filter(botanical %in% c("Bertholletia excelsa","Copaifera reticulata", "Jacaranda copaia", "Vismia cayennensis"))%>%
                        filter(n_la_2025 == 0)%>%
                        flextable() %>% 
                        autofit()
```
